quests.title: The Healers Are Waiting
quests.text: Our healers have patients waiting and no Glass Venom left; I would spare them having to choose who waits longest. Bring me three portions from Glass-Fang Serpents in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} by day. Walk with care among those roots, so your return gives the healers one task fewer.

quests.title: Threads Across the Living Path
quests.text: Glass-Web Jungle Spiders draw their threads across the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} each night, until even familiar paths become snares. Kill six of them after dark. A forest must leave room for more than one kind of hunger.
quests.lesson: The same kind at night; one outing serves both.

quests.title: A Disagreement in the Branches
quests.text: I sent a scout to listen to the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}; the Glass-Knuckle Jungle Apes answered with a branch. Defeat six of them there by day so our watchers can return. Listening to the forest requires a little quiet, and preferably an unbroken head.
quests.lesson: The top belt of Skyglass by day.

quests.title: The Price of Another War
quests.text: {name:paymaster_chirr} pays his Last-Pay Archers with coin stripped from the dead of both banners at the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp} {dir_from_giver:front_skyglass_canopy/paymaster_camp}. Defeat five of those archers and the paymaster himself. We have watched this forest grow through enough wars; he will not purchase another beneath its branches.
quests.lesson: Front climax: the last named normal leader before 60.

quests.title: Group: Beneath the Waiting Coils
quests.text: The branches bend beneath {name:glass_throat_serpent} in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy} {dir_from_giver:glass_throat_serpent}. Gather a group and slay that elite serpent before it takes another of our watchers. There is wisdom in a solitary walk, but this is a task for companions who will watch one another's backs.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 60 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: Eyes Beyond the Lanterns
quests.text: When the lanterns are lit, Glass-Shadow Panthers begin their hunt in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/high_canopy}. Bring down five there after dark, and I will pay a bounty so our watchers can make their rounds. You may accept the bounty again twenty-five minutes after each turn-in. The forest has time to spare; those walking home tonight do not.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, upper Skyglass by night.
